policy.description: Blocking line-coverage ratchets. For a fixed scope, coveredLines is the highest value in the reviewed clean-run observation envelope, never a modal or repeated lower value, and that high-water never decreases. Update the envelope in the same reviewed change whenever scope or coverage advances. A fixed-scope floor may move downward only to the exact minimum directly observed by clean runs on the identical source, tests, and total-line scope, with linked evidence and a bounded tolerance; unexplained coverage loss remains a regression.

tolerance.rationale: Issue #664 adds preferred-audio-language selection on top of the shared BCP-47 resolver, including exact-region/base-language fallbacks, per-user inheritance, acknowledgement-safe whole-file persistence, and server-cache identity fencing. Two clean full client runs on this exact 3,304-line core scope and 2,314-test tree both passed every test and measured 2,919/3,304 (88.347%), advancing the prior 2,918-line high-water by one covered line with no instrumentation spread. The reviewed observed high-water and exact observed floor are therefore both 2,919/3,304 with zero tolerance. coverage-baseline.test.js retains the exact below-floor, above-baseline, scope-change, observed-high-water, and broad-tolerance negative boundaries.

Issue #667 is rebased on the advanced per-category Spoiler Guard implementation from #700 and adds caller-scoped Series/Season language-coverage projection, canonical alias handling, bounded paging, and focused regressions. Four clean full-suite runs on this exact 54,382-line source and 4,261-test scope passed every test and measured 44,605 and 44,610 locally under .NET 10.0.9, then 44,616 on the hosted merge ref at head acf32dcd and 44,617 at head 48815c6f under .NET 10.0.10. The reviewed high-water is therefore 44,617/54,382 (82.044%) and the exact observed floor is 44,605/54,382 (82.022%); the twelve-line timing-dependent instrumentation spread is 0.022 percentage points, far inside the 0.15pp policy bound. Earlier attempts are excluded because one test out of 4,261 failed in each run; two diagnostic reruns identified pre-existing BookmarkRevisionController 2-second timing-budget failures under coverage. coverage-baseline.test.js retains the exact scope-drift, regression, stale-baseline, observed-high-water, spread, single-run, and broad-tolerance negative boundaries.
